rules.condition: x > x2+xs2 / x+xs < x2 / y > y2+ys2 / y+ys < y2
rules.semantic: Effects touch when their axis-aligned boxes overlap or merely share an edge (inclusive bounds): a box exactly one pixel past the other's edge does not touch.

arms.when: overlap or edge-touch on both axes

tests.note: left and up placements one px clear: false on x and on y
far foe 120 px right: separated on x

missing_arms: overlap or edge-touch on both axes
note: The five cited hits tests (EffectAct.hits_overlap2 / hits_no_overlap / hits_contained2, EffectMorePaths.effect_round10_* / effect_round11_hits_edge_touches) call the C++ hits() in src/gameplay/effect.cpp, not this Lua function, so they were removed. Edge-touch inclusivity of the Lua copy is unasserted.
